title: Config, .env Loading, Dual-Mode Server Boot & /health Store Reporting
description: Extend internal/config/config.go with DatabaseURL, DatabaseMaxConns, DatabaseMinConns, and robust .env search up to 6 parent directories. Wire dual-mode initialization in internal/handlers/server.go + cmd/server/main.go (connecting to PostgresStore when DATABASE_URL is reachable, logging warning and falling back to MemoryStore when unset/placeholder/unreachable). Update /health to report store: postgresql or in-memory.
acceptance_criteria: Config loads DATABASE_URL, DATABASE_MAX_CONNS (default 25), DATABASE_MIN_CONNS (default 5) from env or .env
Server.New(cfg) connects to PostgresStore and logs 'connected to Supabase PostgreSQL cluster' when DATABASE_URL is valid and reachable
Server.New(cfg) logs a structured warning and falls back to MemoryStore when DATABASE_URL is empty, unconfigured localhost placeholder, or unreachable
GET /health and GET /api/v1/health return store='postgresql' or store='in-memory' while preserving all existing fields
